description: For a common-head atom family and the same successful answer \(\mu\) of its specified shared term problem, every atom unifier \(\sigma\), including one by ground terms, satisfies \(\mu(x)\rho=\sigma(x)\) for some single residual substitution \(\rho\) on all variables.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atom_unify_factorization.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} (A : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Atom L ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.HeadCompatible A) (μ : ℕ → L.Term ℕ)
  (hμ :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atomProblem A) =
      some μ)
  (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) (hσ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.AtomUnifies σ A) :
  ∃ ρ, ∀ (x : ℕ), (μ x).subst ρ = σ x
